summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Pampa Energy Inc. (Pampa Energía S.A.), an Argentine electric services company, reporting its unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains no announcement of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate event. It includes standard forward-looking statements and financial disclosures. As a periodic financial report, it does not constitute a special-situation category under event-driven analysis.
